title: a personal chat with my sister while snowed in - get to know my family
en: Hello everyone, I hope you you are having a wonderful December, I certainly have. I’ve been spending a lot of time with my family recently, and this week has been focused on trying to create a lot of wonderful memories. So, I realized that while I did have some video projects I was working on nothing was going to come together as i anticipated. I realized it was important to let that go, and take some time to be with my family and honor that time together. My sister is here, Liana. She is one of my favorite people in this world apart from my brother, who is helping me film this video.

Anyway, I know this time of year can be tiring as well as enjoyable and that you find yourself tired in January. I am wishing you the best, that you can rest and recover and embrace the new year as full of possibilities. And I thought since I wont have my sister over here anytime soon, I would have her share one of her New Years goals. Liana: what jumps out at me from what you shared, is I would say to recenter on gratitude and things to be grateful for.

Not taking for granted basic needs, all the blessings in our lives, as a family, as individuals, and how that can let us grow. I’m taking this opportunity to foster that gratitude with people I love. Paola:I would say my New Years resolutions are quite similar. I see in the comments in these videos that are about happiness and how to find happiness, and that usually happiness is more of a location.

If you just find the right place to live, the right environment, then you will be happy. And definitely I understand that, I have lived in some nasty places and having a clean and safe home is lovely, having access to nature is lovely. But when I think about was has made the most impact on my joy on a daily basis, it has been none of that. It’s not about whether or not I have access to a trail or whether or not i have a cottage I can call my own.

None of those have come close to the impact of recognizing I have a safe environment. Not only a safe environment as in a shelter, but having people in your life, and only allowing people in your life, that make you feel safe. I came to appreciate that after experiencing some relationships that didn’t make me feel safe and some environments where I didn’t feel safe. And that is something I really appreciated after coming to a place i did feel relaxed and at ease. And that, knowing that the people around you care about you and will prioritize your safety

above everything else is something, that not so many years ago in a not-so-great place, I would have given anything for and that is what keeps me going today. No matter where my life takes me, whether I need to leave this place or go back to the city, no matter what I do I am going to be so grateful I have that. That is something so special that we often take for granted. Yeah, in my very short live I truly believe happiness isn’t a specific location. It is something that can be cultivated in many places and many walks of life as long as you have your basic needs met, and I know not everyone has those basic needs met. It can take so much time, and at times is can feel so discouraging to try to pursue

and environment that makes you feel your best and makes you feel safe, and I know that’s very hard. So, I’m sending you all my love and I hope you as well can find some lovely New Years resolutions that make you excited about all the possibilities it holds. Anyway, I guess that’s what my New Years resolution is as well, yeah, I really like not to make tactile resolutions. Every year for a while I would say less ice cream, and it would fail every time. Yeah, I’ve given up on a lot of those things. But yeah, my New Years resolution is just being grateful for safety. Fun fact about my sister, she fights.

Liana:I don’t actually fight. I do martial arts. Paola: yeah, she does martial arts, she’s really good. Liana: yeah, it’s more like I try to beat people up and I get beat up, because that’s how I learn. Paola: She fights, I hike. Liana: I like that. Paola:Sending you all my love, thank you so much for being here, and I will see you next week. Liana:Bye!
zh: 大家好，我希望你们度过了一个美好的十二月，我当然也有。最近我花了很多时间和家人在一起，这周我一直致力于创造很多美好的回忆。所以，我意识到，虽然我确实有一些视频项目，但我正在做的事情并没有像我预期的那样完成。我意识到放手是很重要的，花一些时间与家人在一起并珍惜那段在一起的时光。我姐姐在这里，莉安娜。除了帮我拍摄这段视频的哥哥之外，她是这个世界上我最喜欢的人之一。
不管怎样，我知道一年中的这个时候可能会很累，也可能很愉快，而且一月份你会发现自己很累。我祝愿你一切顺利，能够休息、恢复并拥抱充满可能性的新一年。我想既然我不会很快让我妹妹来这里，我会让她分享她的新年目标之一。利亚娜：从你分享的内容中，我突然想到的是，我想说的是，要重新关注感恩和值得感恩的事情。
不要把基本需求、我们生活中的所有祝福（作为一个家庭、作为个人）视为理所当然，以及它们如何让我们成长。我借此机会向我所爱的人表达感激之情。保拉：我想说我的新年决心非常相似。我在这些视频的评论中看到关于幸福以及如何找到幸福的内容，而通常幸福更多的是一个位置。
如果你找到了合适的居住地、合适的环境，那么你就会幸福。我当然明白，我住在一些肮脏的地方，拥有一个干净安全的家是可爱的，接触大自然是可爱的。但当我想到对我每天的快乐影响最大的时候，我发现它都不是。这与我是否有机会进入小径或我是否拥有一间可以称之为自己的小屋无关。
这些都比不上认识到我有一个安全的环境所产生的影响。不仅仅是避难所这样的安全环境，还有人们在你的生活中，并且只允许人们在你的生活中，这会让你感到安全。在经历了一些不让我感到安全的人际关系和一些让我感到不安全的环境后，我开始意识到这一点。在来到一个我确实感到放松和自在的地方后，这是我真正感激的事情。并且知道您周围的人关心您并将优先考虑您的安全

最重要的是，就在几年前，在一个不太好的地方，我愿意为之付出一切，而这正是我今天继续前进的动力。无论我的生活带我去哪里，无论我需要离开这个地方还是回到城市，无论我做什么，我都会非常感激我拥有它。这是非常特别的事情，我们常常认为这是理所当然的。是的，在我短暂的一生中，我坚信幸福不是一个特定的地点。只要你满足了你的基本需求，它就可以在许多地方和许多行业中培养，但我知道并不是每个人都满足了这些基本需求。这可能会花费很多时间，有时会让人感到很沮丧去尝试追求
以及让你感觉最好、让你感到安全的环境，我知道这很难。所以，我向你致以我全部的爱，我希望你也能找到一些可爱的新年决心，让你对它所蕴含的所有可能性感到兴奋。不管怎样，我想这也是我的新年决心，是的，我真的不喜欢做出触觉上的决心。每年有一段时间我都会说少吃冰淇淋，但每次都会失败。是的，我已经放弃了很多这样的事情。但是，是的，我的新年决心就是感谢安全。关于我姐姐的有趣事实是，她打架。
莉安娜：我实际上不打架。我是练武术的Paola：是的，她会武术，她真的很棒。利亚娜：是的，这更像是我试图殴打别人，但我却被殴打，因为这就是我学习的方式。宝拉：她打架，我徒步。莉安娜：我喜欢这样。宝拉：向您致以我全部的爱，非常感谢您来到这里，我们下周见。莉安娜：再见！
